output.objection: You are treating my agreement to keep the data contracts manual as a permanent concession, but I only accepted that trade off to protect the release date. Please acknowledge that this is a temporary state that we must plan to automate in the next sprint, not a new baseline.
output.correction: I did not say the manual process is acceptable long term, I said it is the only way to ship on time without breaking the pipeline. Do not file this as a permanent reduction in scope, it is a specific trade off for this single release.
